items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Rex Stewart was promoting some of my jazz things out in Long Island

ctx.x: Pardon me. How long had you been married to Cliff?

Well, eight years, around seven or eight years, 1950 to 1957. So he stopped in at Mannys and said Maxine wants a valve Trombone. So Manny said a guy just walked in here yesterday with a valvetrombone and he said it's $65 so Cliff came back and told me. I told him to go and get it so he brought it home wrapped up in newspaper and we had a friend that lives up here in the Bronx, Herb Branch, a very good teacher, a very good trumpet player. He was retired. So he took me over there and I took lessons and Rex Stewart…
